text:
ava.s: Hey team — AcmePay SIG is on my plate, due EOD Friday. They asked Q3.2 (KMS rotation proof) and Q7.1 (encryption at rest). Do we have the artifact locations?

diego.k: I have the KMS rotation log export in S3 but it's a generated CSV from our audit job. Link is internal-only: s3://redwood-secibility/acmepay/sig/kms-rotation-2025.csv — need to confirm redaction.

maya.t: For Q7.1 we can point to the architecture diagram + config blob in Confluence. Page: https://confluence.redwood.ai/security/acmepay-sig (internal). Also we have the encryption config snippet in repo.

ava.s: Can someone paste the exact config snippet for the doc? Customer expects a short code sample they can attach. Keep it short.

diego.k: Pasting minimal snippet: ```json
{"encryption": {"at_rest": "AES-256", "kms": "aws-kms", "key_rotation": "30d"}}
``` Note: remove internal ARN values before sharing.

liam.r: Heads-up on timelines — finance needs to finalise commit terms before we mark SIG complete. Not a blocker for evidence but fyi for the CS handoff.

ava.s: Good call @liam.r — I'll queue pricing note separately. Back to evidence — @diego.k can you provide a sanitized CSV sample (one row) we can include?

diego.k: Uploaded one-row sample to the Confluence page under attachments and added a footnote about redaction. Also added a short description of how rotation is enforced by our rotation lambda.

maya.t: Quick checklist for the thread so we don't miss anything: 1) sanitized rotation CSV, 2) config snippet, 3) architecture diagram + caption, 4) statement of applicability for AcmePay (no PHI stored). I'm adding that to the Confluence page.

ava.s: Perfect. Can we also include an ops contact for follow-up? Diego?

diego.k: Yep — diego.k@redwood.ai and security-oncall@redwood.ai.

sig-bot: Reminder: SIG questionnaire for workspace AcmePay due in 72 hours. Please attach final artifacts to the Confluence checklist.

ava.s: Thanks — I'm going to assemble the zipped evidence package and send to AcmePay security. Will ping here when it's sent. :thumbsup:

liam.r: If they ask about retention policy, point them to the data-retention matrix on the same Confluence page. I added a short blurb.

ava.s: Closing loop — will upload final zip and paste link here once done. ETA: today 4pm PT.

maya.t: If AcmePay requests a signed statement, let me know and I can coordinate with legal.

ava.s: noted. Thanks everyone.
